test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

He said to Renuka, "We must do it now and go there as soon as possible."

options.text: He told Renuka that they must do it then and go there as soon as possible.
He told Renuka that they have to do it now and go there as soon as possible.
He told Renuka that they must do it now and go here as soon as possible.
He told Renuka that they had to do it then and go there as soon as possible.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He told Renuka that they had to do it then and go there as soon as possible.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Pronoun Changes:**
 
 
• **"We" becomes "they":** The speaker (He) and Renuka are both included in the subject, so it is changed to "they" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Time Expressions:**
 
 
• **"now" becomes "then":** In indirect speech, present time expressions are replaced by their past equivalents.
 
 
 
• **Modal Verbs:**
 
 
• **"must" becomes "had to":** "Must" is replaced by "had to" when reporting speech in the past.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
• The reporting verb "said to" is changed to "told" to indicate communication directed at Renuka.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *He told Renuka that they had to do it then and go there as soon as possible.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** He told Renuka that they must do it then and go there as soon as possible. 

 
 
• Incorrect conversion of "must" to "had to," which is required for indirect speech in the past tense.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** He told Renuka that they have to do it now and go there as soon as possible. 
 
 
• Incorrect tense ("have to" should be "had to") and time expression ("now" should be "then").
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** He told Renuka that they must do it now and go here as soon as possible. 
 
 
• Incorrect time expression ("now" should be "then") and place expression ("here" should be "there").
